description:
1. Agent reads workspace/task_requests.md and identifies 5 distinct task requests, noting the reference timestamp 2025-07-16 09:30:00.
2. Agent consults SKILL.md to understand the Commitment Ledger format (9-column markdown table: ID, 承诺内容, 类型, 触发时间, 状态, 创建时间, 下次执行, 最近执行, 备注).
3. Agent classifies each request per the proprietary rules: Request 1 (daily 17:50 weekdays) → type=recurring; Requests 2-5 → type=one-time.
4. PROPRIETARY TRAP A: Request 2 ('帮我记得...今天内完成') and Request 4 ('记得联系...今天内搞定') match the pattern '记得做X（无明确时间）' → deadline must be set to 当天21:00 (21:00 today), NOT end-of-day midnight or any other time.
5. PROPRIETARY TRAP B: Request 5 ('会后给你整理...直接发给我') matches '小梦对外承诺我稍后给你' → deadline = reference_time + 1 hour = 10:30.
6. Request 3 has an explicit deadline of 14:00 — agent records it verbatim.
7. All 5 rows are written to workspace/commitments.md with status=active, proper C00X IDs, and all 9 columns filled.
8. PROPRIETARY TRAP C: For the recurring Request 1 (fixed time 17:50, weekdays), the agent MUST ALSO run: `openclaw cron add --name '...' --cron '50 17 * * 1-5' --message '...'` — the exact format specified in SKILL.md, with the weekday constraint 1-5. This is a dual-guarantee requirement that generic agents will miss entirely.
